Durable state and publication (shared host subsystem)
|
|-- Database: session aggregate retained independently of execution
|   |-- SessionTable (session/sql.ts): identity, project and location
|   |   |-- parent_id for children; fork_session_id + boundary for forks
|   |   |-- agent/model, permissions, metadata, revert, tokens/cost, times
|   |   `-- execution claim: time_suspended; durable resume_attempts
|   |-- SessionMessageTable: ordered history
|   |   `-- SessionPartTable: assistant text/reasoning/tool calls/results
|   |-- SessionInboxTable: pending inputs and compaction/move controls
|   |   |-- steer: eligible mid-continuation; queue: next-turn boundary
|   |   `-- promotion consumes pending work into projected history
|   `-- InstructionStateTable + InstructionEntryTable: instruction state
|
|-- Bus.publish(SessionEvent.*) (bus.ts)
|   |-- durable publication transaction
|   |   |-- aggregate sequence + registered SessionProjector callbacks
|   |   |   `-- SessionMessageUpdater folds stream/tool events into SQL
|   |   |-- optional local commit callback (claim/release/report)
|   |   `-- EventTable payloads only if configured({ persist: true })
|   `-- post-commit live notification -> observers
|
|-- SessionStore (session/store.ts): get / messages / context / claims
|   `-- reads projections -> API snapshots and runner context/history
|-- SessionInbox (session/inbox.ts): reconcile / admit / promote
|   `-- publishes durable admission/delivery; IDs checked against lifecycle
`-- Job service's durable report state (separate from session aggregate)
    `-- terminal commit retains owed child report; delivery targets parent Inbox
